scripts.package:linux: npm run build:binary && mkdir -p dist/release && cp dist/forge dist/release/forge && cp scripts/install-linux.sh dist/release/install.sh && chmod +x dist/release/forge dist/release/install.sh && tar -czf dist/cognautic-forge-linux.tar.gz -C dist/release forge install.sh
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:binary && mkdir -p dist/release && cp dist/forge dist/release/forge && cp scripts/install-macos.sh dist/release/install.sh && chmod +x dist/release/forge dist/release/install.sh && tar -czf dist/cognautic-forge-macos.tar.gz -C dist/release forge install.sh
scripts.package:win: npm run build:binary:win && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-windows.ps1
scripts.package:all: npm run package:linux && npm run package:mac && (command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run package:win || echo 'Skipping package:win (powershell not found)')
